text: あれも　マサキが　つくったんだぜ　おまえも　つかってるんなら　いちど　おれいに　いけば？

structure.jp: あれも　マサキが　つくったんだぜ
structure.en: Bill made that too, you know

structure.jp: おまえも　つかってるんなら
いちど　おれいに　いけば？
structure.en: why not go once to thank him?

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ and gives the feeling of 'the fact is', explaining something to the listener. つくったんだぜ = 'he made it, you know'.

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら means 'if that is the case'. つかってる is the shortened spoken form of つかっている. つかってるんなら = 'if you're using it'.

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: ば means 'if', and ending a sentence on it is a casual 'why don't you'. おれいに here means 'in order to thank'. おれいに いけば？ = 'why not go and thank him?'
